g.text: No database server: DuckDB queries Parquet in memory; the frontend shares one typed contract (docs/api-contract.ts)
Overview — KPIs · sentiment trend · theme river · calendar
Knowledge graph — Sigma.js WebGL · Louvain · PageRank
Tailwind v4 · Radix/shadcn primitives · ECharts · GSAP motion
Prebuilt data → `docker compose up --build` → http://localhost:3000 (API docs at :8000/docs). Tests: pytest = unit + API contract + metric regression gate.
